from typing import Final

from .algorithm import bubble_sort

__all__ = ["DEFAULT_VALUES", "main", "sorted_default_values"]

DEFAULT_VALUES: Final[tuple[int, ...]] = (64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90)


def sorted_default_values() -> list[int]:
    values = list(DEFAULT_VALUES)
    bubble_sort(values)
    return values


def main() -> None:
    print(sorted_default_values())

import importlib
import sys

import pytest

from bubble_sort import bubble_sort
from bubble_sort.cli import main, sorted_default_values

SORT_CASES = (
    ((64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90), [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]),
    ((3, -1, 3, 0, -1), [-1, -1, 0, 3, 3]),
    ((), []),
    ((1,), [1]),
)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("input_values", "expected"), SORT_CASES)
def test_bubble_sort_sorts_in_place(input_values, expected) -> None:
    values = list(input_values)

    result = bubble_sort(values)

    assert result is None
    assert values == expected


def test_legacy_bubble_sort_name_still_works() -> None:
    from sort import bubbleSort

    values = [2, 1]

    result = bubbleSort(values)

    assert result is None
    assert values == [1, 2]


def test_importing_legacy_module_has_no_demo_output(capsys) -> None:
    sys.modules.pop("sort", None)

    importlib.import_module("sort")

    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == ""
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_sorted_default_values_returns_sorted_copy() -> None:
    assert sorted_default_values() == [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]


def test_cli_prints_sorted_default_values(capsys) -> None:
    main()

    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]\n"
